name: Resume has a 10-month gap; HR never probes it
notes: Acme ends Mar 2022, Initech starts Jan 2023. HR session covers notice and comp but never asks about the gap — coaching nudge: prep the one-liner.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Thanks for joining. Tell me about yourself.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a backend engineer with around 3 years across two companies, mostly working on Java services and Postgres.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What's your notice period and earliest start date?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days notice. Buyout is possible. Earliest LWD would be late February.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: And your current CTC plus expectations?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Current is 22 LPA fixed + 3 variable. Looking for around 32 LPA fixed at the new role.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yes — what's the team's roadmap for the next two quarters, and what does success look like at the 90-day mark?
